name: holo-mind
description: Holo's mind: a local heartbeat loop that reads the creature's neural state, asks an LLM (BlockRun x402, paid per-request in USDC on Base) for a first-person narration + a structured intent, runs that intent past a deterministic policy gate, and records the narration to an isolated private darkroom store. The LLM only proposes; hardcoded policy decides. No money moves and nothing publishes until an approval rail exists.
